viewAndCreate-token.description: Allow all users to view and create tasks (token path)

viewAndCreate-user.description: Allow all users to view and create tasks (user path)

policy_content.body:
@id("viewAndCreate-user")
permit(principal is TaskApp::User, action in [TaskApp::Action::"ViewTask", TaskApp::Action::"CreateTask"], resource);

ownerModify-token.description: Allow task owners to update and delete tasks (token path)

ownerModify-user.description: Allow task owners to update and delete tasks (user path)
